regressions.rule: Keep a compound free-pointer value bound to the temporary of its read and print uses through it (substitute only constants or variable + constant); unify temporaries read from mem[64] with no write to mem[64] between them, and cancel their difference.

new_findings.source: _verifySig: owner() call, ECDSA.recover string reverts, IERC1271.isValidSignature
new_findings.issue: Where the free pointer is symbolic after a join, data written at mem[64] + k just before a call or revert are not resolved: the selector is printed in the function-name position as a memory slice and the ECDSA messages stay raw (one half-folded), while the same code in verify, verifyAuthorized, castAuthorized and castChainAgnostic is fully decoded.
new_findings.rule: Writes at mem[64] + k with mem[64] unchanged since are as resolvable as writes at constant addresses: decode call and revert data from them the same way, and never print a memory slice as a function name.

improvements: P6 fixed (whole-byte hex). GAS reads now set where the code reads them: per action inside the loop in executeOperation/_callTargets (the old text hoisted two reads out of the loop) and at function start in castAuthorized. The EIP-712 domain separator and struct hashes are resolved as sha3 of their constants in every digest. Custom errors (0xec925985, 0x70a17179, 0xa8398eb9) and ECDSA messages decoded, calls named (_owner(), isValidSignature(bytes32, bytes) with args), returns 1 / 0x1626ba7e direct. Dominated Panic(50) checks dropped, the duplicated params decoding hoisted out of both arms in executeOperation, 397 fewer lines.
notes: Diff 9338 lines, reviewed by structure: per-function counts of calls, events, reverts, storage writes, returns and loops, plus control-statement diffs, for all 18 changed functions. executeOperation's large hunks are a shift (98% identical after renaming temporaries). signers/isSigner only swapped places; isSigner's _17 = _4 is right. 227 while blocks before and after. P3: the struct-array allocation loops (getChainAgnosticHashes, getSigDigestChainAgnostic) now print one peeled iteration before a do-while (was two), with n >= 2 guaranteed by the revert before.
summary: One medium regression: verifyChainAgnostic's guard reverts merged into one tail, nesting the whole body; low ones from exact free-pointer values printed in full (longer lines, uncancelled pointer differences), negative-first sums and executeOperation's return as raw memory. Large gains: GAS reads placed correctly, digests resolved, custom errors, ECDSA messages and calls decoded.
